title: Uniform Convergence of Generalized Conditional Fréchet Means with Applications to Weighted Fréchet Aggregation and Exceedance Set Estimation
summary: The statistical analysis of object oriented data in non-Euclidean spaces heavily relies on generalized conditional Fréchet means, notably in the context of Fréchet regression. However, establishing the uniform convergence of these estimators presents several theoretical challenges. The difficulties are caused primarily by the absence of linear structures in general metric spaces, rendering standard techniques for verifying the asymptotic uniform equicontinuity of the estimator largely intractable.
